recognize_zh: 骨髓切片旁有骨小樑，骨髓腔大多是脂肪與疏鬆水腫狀基質，細胞明顯偏少；殘存的細胞多為單一形態的中型單核細胞，核卵圓或凹陷、染色質開放並見小核仁，缺乏成熟造血，符合低細胞性骨髓中以母細胞為主的 AML。
features: Hypocellular marrow with abundant fat and loose, edematous stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula
Residual cellularity dominated by scattered, loosely arranged intermediate-sized mononuclear cells
Round, oval to indented/folded nuclei with open, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Paucity of maturing granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic elements; no megakaryocytes in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypocellular marrow with abundant adipose tissue and loose edematous stroma adjacent to an unremarkable bony trabecula. The residual hematopoietic cells consist predominantly of a monotonous population of intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with round to indented nuclei, fine open chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, arranged singly and in loose clusters. Maturing trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, is markedly diminished. In conjunction with aspirate and immunophenotypic findings, this represents hypocellular marrow replaced predominantly by blasts, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the t(9;11)(p22;q23) establishes AML with KMT2A-MLLT3.

ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow is hypocellular but residual cells are lymphocytes, plasma cells and mast cells without clusters of blasts; CD34 IHC shows no increase.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and fewer than 20% blasts, whereas blasts dominate here (CD34/CD117 IHC to quantify).
Serous atrophy shows extracellular pale mucoid material with fat atrophy and sparse normal hematopoietic cells rather than an atypical immature population.
